name: skript-extension
description: Skript syntax highlighting, snippets, and variable IntelliSense for skript development

skript.scan.glob.description: Glob of files to index for variable and function IntelliSense. Changing it triggers a full rescan.

skript.scan.exclude.description: Glob of files to exclude from indexing. Changing it triggers a full rescan.

skript.scan.includeDisabledFiles.description: Index files whose name starts with "-" (Skript ignores them). When true their entries are marked "(disabled)"; when false they are not indexed at all.

skript.diagnostics.enabled.description: Report Skript problems (indentation, wait inside inventory click, undefined options, ...) in the Problems panel.

skript.diagnostics.rules.description: Per-rule toggles keyed by diagnostic code, e.g. { "wait-in-inventory-click": false }. Unlisted rules stay enabled.

skript.diagnostics.knownFunctions.description: Function names defined outside the workspace (addons, other servers) that diagnostics should treat as defined.

skript.format.enabled.description: Register the reindent-on-save formatter for Skript files. Disable to keep your own formatter.

skript.completion.preselectVariables.description: Preselect the closest matching variable in the {…} completion list so Enter accepts it immediately.
